newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise sells retirement home unit.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise sells retirement home unit.

text.p: French utilities company Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Tuesday it has sold its wholly-owned subsidiary Lyonnaise Sante Semacs to the Burel group for an undisclosed amount.

Lyonnaise Sante Semacs provides accommodation for elderly people. It has 10 medical/residential centres in the Paris and Lyon region under the MAPI brand with capacity of 1,200 beds. The company has 1996 sales of 175 million francs.
The sale is part of the group's concentration on core activities, the company said in a statement.
